items.t: Oversaw the international, appellate, and policy work of the Justice Department's Antitrust Division as Deputy Assistant Attorney General.
items.q: Maggie Goodlander was a Deputy Assistant Attorney General at the U.S. Department of Justice where she oversaw the international, appellate, and policy work of the Antitrust Division.

items.t: Advised Attorney General Merrick Garland on antitrust enforcement, consumer protection, and the Justice Department's budget while serving as his Counselor.
items.q: Maggie served as Counselor to Attorney General Merrick Garland and advised the Attorney General on a wide range of legal, policy, and management matters, including antitrust enforcement, consumer protection, and the development and execution of the Justice Department’s $35.3 billion budget.

items.t: Helped launch the Justice Department's Office for Access to Justice and Office for Environmental Justice.
items.q: In addition, she helped launch two new components within the Justice Department: the Office for Access to Justice and the Office for Environmental Justice.
